AA_ASSERTION_OF_ARGUMENTS.fix: Validate public arguments with Objects.requireNonNull or an explicit check that throws IllegalArgumentException; assert is skipped when assertions are off.

AM_CREATES_EMPTY_JAR_FILE_ENTRY.fix: Write the entry's bytes between putNextEntry and closeEntry, or drop the entry if it is not needed.

AM_CREATES_EMPTY_ZIP_FILE_ENTRY.fix: Write the entry's bytes between putNextEntry and closeEntry, or drop the entry if it is not needed.

ASE_ASSERTION_WITH_SIDE_EFFECT.fix: Run the state-changing call on its own line, store the result in a local, and assert on the local.

ASE_ASSERTION_WITH_SIDE_EFFECT_METHOD.fix: Call the mutating method outside the assert, keep the result in a local, and assert on that local.

AT_NONATOMIC_64BIT_PRIMITIVE.fix: Make the long or double field volatile, use AtomicLong, or guard every read and write with the same lock.

AT_NONATOMIC_OPERATIONS_ON_SHARED_VARIAB.fix: Use AtomicInteger or AtomicReference (incrementAndGet, updateAndGet), or hold one lock across the whole read-modify-write.

AT_OPERATION_SEQUENCE_ON_CONCURRENT_ABST.fix: Replace the check-then-act on the concurrent map with one atomic call: putIfAbsent, computeIfAbsent, compute or merge.

AT_STALE_THREAD_WRITE_OF_PRIMITIVE.fix: Make the field volatile or an atomic type, or guard every read and write of it with the same lock.

AT_UNSAFE_RESOURCE_ACCESS_IN_THREAD.fix: Guard the shared resource with one lock around each use, or open a separate instance per thread in try-with-resources.

BAC_BAD_APPLET_CONSTRUCTOR.fix: Move the work that needs the AppletStub (getParameter, getCodeBase, getDocumentBase) out of the constructor into init().

BC_BAD_CAST_TO_ABSTRACT_COLLECTION.fix: Declare the parameter or return type as List, Set or Map instead of Collection, or copy with List.copyOf(c) rather than casting.

BC_BAD_CAST_TO_CONCRETE_COLLECTION.fix: Declare the type as the interface (List, Set, Map) and drop the cast to ArrayList or HashMap.

BC_EQUALS_METHOD_SHOULD_WORK_FOR_ALL_OBJ.fix: Start equals with a pattern-matching instanceof check and return false for other types instead of casting or throwing.

BC_IMPOSSIBLE_CAST.fix: Remove the cast or fix the variable's declared type so the cast can succeed; otherwise it always throws ClassCastException.

BC_IMPOSSIBLE_CAST_PRIMITIVE_ARRAY.fix: Cast to the array type the value really has, or change the declared type; a primitive array never casts to another array type.

BC_IMPOSSIBLE_DOWNCAST.fix: Drop the downcast or build the value as the subtype; check the runtime type with instanceof pattern matching before casting.

BC_IMPOSSIBLE_DOWNCAST_OF_TOARRAY.fix: Call toArray(new String[0]) with a typed array argument instead of casting the Object[] result.

BC_IMPOSSIBLE_INSTANCEOF.fix: Delete the instanceof test or fix the types; the compared types are unrelated, so the check is always false.

BC_UNCONFIRMED_CAST.fix: Guard the cast with a pattern instanceof (if (o instanceof Foo foo)), or change the declared type so no cast is needed.

BC_UNCONFIRMED_CAST_OF_RETURN_VALUE.fix: Check the returned value with a pattern instanceof before using it as the subtype, or make the method return the subtype.

BC_VACUOUS_INSTANCEOF.fix: Remove the instanceof test, since the static type already guarantees it; use == null if a null check was meant.

BIT_ADD_OF_SIGNED_BYTE.fix: Mask the byte before combining: (b & 0xFF) in the addition or OR.

BIT_AND.fix: Fix the mask or the compared constant so the test can match; then compare (flags & MASK) != 0 for a membership check.

BIT_AND_ZZ.fix: The mask is 0, so (e & 0) == 0 is always true: use the intended non-zero mask, or delete the test.

BIT_IOR.fix: Use & to test bits, (flags & MASK) != 0, and parenthesize mixed expressions like (e & (A | B)) == C.

BIT_IOR_OF_SIGNED_BYTE.fix: Mask the byte before ORing it into a wider value: (b & 0xFF) << 8 | (c & 0xFF).

BIT_SIGNED_CHECK.fix: Compare the masked value against 0 with != 0, not > 0, because the sign bit makes > 0 wrong: (flags & MASK) != 0.

BIT_SIGNED_CHECK_HIGH_BIT.fix: Test the bit with (x & MASK) != 0 instead of > 0, since the mask's high bit makes the result negative.

BOA_BADLY_OVERRIDDEN_ADAPTER.fix: Fix the method signature so it overrides the listener adapter method, and add @Override so the compiler checks it.

BSHIFT_WRONG_ADD_PRIORITY.fix: Add parentheses to say which you mean: (a << 8) + b or a << (8 + b); + binds tighter than <<.

BX_BOXING_IMMEDIATELY_UNBOXED.fix: Use the primitive directly (Integer.parseInt, an int variable) instead of boxing a value and calling intValue() on it.

BX_BOXING_IMMEDIATELY_UNBOXED_TO_PERFORM.fix: Convert with a cast such as (double) count instead of boxing and unboxing the value.

BX_UNBOXED_AND_COERCED_FOR_TERNARY_OPERA.fix: Give both ternary branches the same type, all boxed or all primitive, so no hidden unboxing or numeric promotion happens.

BX_UNBOXING_IMMEDIATELY_REBOXED.fix: Keep the value as the boxed type and pass it along; do not call intValue() and box it again.

CAA_COVARIANT_ARRAY_ELEMENT_STORE.fix: Use a List<T> or an array of the exact element type so stores cannot hit ArrayStoreException.

CAA_COVARIANT_ARRAY_FIELD.fix: Declare the field with the element type you actually store (String[], not Object[]), or hold a List instead of an array.

CAA_COVARIANT_ARRAY_LOCAL.fix: Declare the local with the element type you actually store (String[], not Object[]), or use a List.

CAA_COVARIANT_ARRAY_RETURN.fix: Declare the return type with the element type you actually return (String[], not Object[]), or return a List.

CD_CIRCULAR_DEPENDENCY.fix: Break the cycle: move the shared logic into a third class or behind an interface that both classes depend on.

CI_CONFUSED_INHERITANCE.fix: Make the protected member of the final class private, since nothing can inherit it.

CNT_ROUGH_CONSTANT_VALUE.fix: Use the exact constant, such as Math.PI or Math.E, instead of a rounded literal.

CN_IDIOM.fix: Remove implements Cloneable and offer a copy constructor or static copy factory; if clone is needed, override it calling super.clone().

CN_IDIOM_NO_SUPER_CALL.fix: Obtain the copy through super.clone() in clone, or drop clone and use a copy constructor.

CN_IMPLEMENTS_CLONE_BUT_NOT_CLONEABLE.fix: Replace clone with a copy constructor or static factory, or declare implements Cloneable and call super.clone().

CO_ABSTRACT_SELF.fix: Declare the abstract class implements Comparable<ItsType>, so compareTo(ItsType) overrides it, and mark it @Override.

CO_COMPARETO_INCORRECT_FLOATING.fix: Compare floating-point values with Double.compare or Float.compare, not by subtracting or casting the difference to int.

CO_COMPARETO_RESULTS_MIN_VALUE.fix: Return -1, 0 or 1, or use Integer.compare, instead of Integer.MIN_VALUE from compareTo.

CO_SELF_NO_OBJECT.fix: Declare implements Comparable<Foo>, so compareTo(Foo) overrides the interface method, and mark it @Override.

CT_CONSTRUCTOR_THROW.fix: Make the class final (records already are), or validate in a static factory method before calling a private constructor.

CWO_CLOSED_WITHOUT_OPENED.fix: Call lock() right before the try whose finally calls unlock(): lock.lock(); try { ... } finally { lock.unlock(); }.

DB_DUPLICATE_BRANCHES.fix: Drop the condition and keep one copy of the code, or fix the branch that was meant to differ.

DB_DUPLICATE_SWITCH_CLAUSES.fix: Merge the identical cases into one arrow label (case A, B -> ...), or fix the clause that was meant to differ.

DCN_NULLPOINTER_EXCEPTION.fix: Test the reference with an explicit null check, or Objects.requireNonNull at the entry, instead of catching NullPointerException.

DC_DOUBLECHECK.fix: Use an eager static final field or a holder class for lazy init, or make the field volatile; do not rely on an unsynchronized first check.

DC_PARTIALLY_CONSTRUCTED.fix: Build the object in a local variable and assign it to the field last, and make that field volatile.

DE_MIGHT_DROP.fix: Handle the exception: log it, return a failure value, or rethrow wrapped as new IllegalStateException(msg, e).

DE_MIGHT_IGNORE.fix: Handle the exception: log it, return a failure value, or rethrow wrapped as new IllegalStateException(msg, e).

DLS_DEAD_LOCAL_INCREMENT_IN_RETURN.fix: Return the new value with return i + 1; or increment the field, not a local that is discarded.

DLS_DEAD_LOCAL_STORE.fix: Delete the assignment whose value is never read, or use the value; keep just the call if its side effect is needed.

DLS_DEAD_LOCAL_STORE_IN_RETURN.fix: Return the expression directly instead of assigning it to a local that is then not used.

DLS_DEAD_LOCAL_STORE_OF_NULL.fix: Delete the assignment of null to the local; narrow the variable's scope so it goes out of scope by itself.

DLS_DEAD_LOCAL_STORE_SHADOWS_FIELD.fix: Assign the field as this.name, or rename the local so it no longer hides the field.

DLS_DEAD_STORE_OF_CLASS_LITERAL.fix: Delete the unused assignment of the class literal; to force class initialization use Class.forName(name, true, loader).

DLS_OVERWRITTEN_INCREMENT.fix: Write i++ alone, not i = i++; the assignment overwrites the increment.

DL_SYNCHRONIZATION_ON_BOOLEAN.fix: Synchronize on a private final Object lock = new Object() field instead of a Boolean.

DL_SYNCHRONIZATION_ON_BOXED_PRIMITIVE.fix: Synchronize on a private final Object lock = new Object() field instead of a boxed number that may be shared.

DL_SYNCHRONIZATION_ON_INTERNED_STRING.fix: Synchronize on a private final Object lock = new Object() field instead of a String literal or interned string.

DL_SYNCHRONIZATION_ON_SHARED_CONSTANT.fix: Synchronize on a private final Object lock = new Object() field instead of a constant other code can also reach.

DL_SYNCHRONIZATION_ON_UNSHARED_BOXED_PRI.fix: Synchronize on a private final Object lock = new Object() field instead of a boxed number whose identity changes on reassignment.

DMI_ANNOTATION_IS_NOT_VISIBLE_TO_REFLECT.fix: Add @Retention(RetentionPolicy.RUNTIME) to the annotation type being looked up through reflection.

DMI_ARGUMENTS_WRONG_ORDER.fix: Pass the arguments in the order the method declares them; swap the call's arguments.

DMI_BAD_MONTH.fix: Use java.time (LocalDate.of(2024, Month.MARCH, 1)) or Calendar.MARCH; Calendar months run 0 to 11.

DMI_BIGDECIMAL_CONSTRUCTED_FROM_DOUBLE.fix: Build it with BigDecimal.valueOf(d) or new BigDecimal("0.1") from a string, not new BigDecimal(double).

DMI_BLOCKING_METHODS_ON_URL.fix: Use java.net.URI for equals, hashCode and map keys; build a URL from the URI only when opening a connection.

DMI_CALLING_NEXT_FROM_HASNEXT.fix: Make hasNext() side-effect free; read ahead into a field and have next() return it.

DMI_COLLECTIONS_SHOULD_NOT_CONTAIN_THEMS.fix: Pass a different collection to contains, remove, or containsAll; a collection is not an element of itself.

DMI_COLLECTION_OF_URLS.fix: Store URI values in the Set or Map keys instead of URL, and convert with uri.toURL() only when connecting.

DMI_CONSTANT_DB_PASSWORD.fix: Read the database password from the environment or a secrets store at startup and pass it in as a parameter.

DMI_DOH.fix: Remove or correct the call; with these arguments it has no effect or always fails.

DMI_EMPTY_DB_PASSWORD.fix: Configure a real database password from the environment or a secrets store and pass it in as a parameter.

DMI_ENTRY_SETS_MAY_REUSE_ENTRY_OBJECTS.fix: Copy each entry with Map.entry(e.getKey(), e.getValue()) before collecting it, or collect keys and values separately.

DMI_FUTILE_ATTEMPT_TO_CHANGE_MAXPOOL_SIZ.fix: Call setCorePoolSize on the ScheduledThreadPoolExecutor; setMaximumPoolSize does nothing there.

DMI_HARDCODED_ABSOLUTE_FILENAME.fix: Take the path as a parameter or a configuration value, or resolve it against Path.of with a relative or temp directory.

DMI_INVOKING_HASHCODE_ON_ARRAY.fix: Use Arrays.hashCode(array), or Arrays.deepHashCode for nested arrays.

DMI_INVOKING_TOSTRING_ON_ANONYMOUS_ARRAY.fix: Use Arrays.toString(new String[] {...}) or just pass the values to List.of.

DMI_INVOKING_TOSTRING_ON_ARRAY.fix: Use Arrays.toString(array), or Arrays.deepToString for nested arrays.

DMI_LONG_BITS_TO_DOUBLE_INVOKED_ON_INT.fix: Pass a long to Double.longBitsToDouble, or use Float.intBitsToFloat for an int.

DMI_NONSERIALIZABLE_OBJECT_WRITTEN.fix: Make the written class implement Serializable, or write a serializable copy (a record of the needed fields).

DMI_RANDOM_USED_ONLY_ONCE.fix: Create one Random and reuse it as a field, or call ThreadLocalRandom.current().nextInt(bound).

DMI_SCHEDULED_THREAD_POOL_EXECUTOR_WITH_.fix: Give ScheduledThreadPoolExecutor a core pool size of at least 1, or use Executors.newSingleThreadScheduledExecutor().

DMI_THREAD_PASSED_WHERE_RUNNABLE_EXPECTE.fix: Pass a Runnable lambda or method reference to the executor or Thread constructor instead of a Thread object.

DMI_UNSUPPORTED_METHOD.fix: Call the supported API instead of the method that always throws UnsupportedOperationException.

DMI_USELESS_SUBSTRING.fix: Use the original String directly instead of substring(0), which returns the same content.

DMI_USING_REMOVEALL_TO_CLEAR_COLLECTION.fix: Call clear() on the collection instead of removeAll(sameCollection).

DMI_VACUOUS_CALL_TO_EASYMOCK_METHOD.fix: Pass the mock object to replay, verify or reset; with no mock argument the call does nothing. Prefer Mockito.

DMI_VACUOUS_SELF_COLLECTION_CALL.fix: Remove the call or pass a different collection; calling containsAll, removeAll or retainAll with itself does nothing useful.

DM_BOXED_PRIMITIVE_FOR_COMPARE.fix: Compare primitives with Integer.compare(a, b) or Double.compare(a, b) instead of boxing one side to call compareTo.

DM_BOXED_PRIMITIVE_FOR_PARSING.fix: Call the primitive parser, such as Integer.parseInt(s), instead of Integer.valueOf(s) followed by intValue().

DM_BOXED_PRIMITIVE_TOSTRING.fix: Call the static Integer.toString(x) or String.valueOf(x) instead of boxing the value to call toString().

DM_CONVERT_CASE.fix: Pass a locale: s.toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT) or s.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).

DM_DEFAULT_ENCODING.fix: Pass a charset explicitly, such as StandardCharsets.UTF_8 to getBytes, InputStreamReader, FileReader or new String.

DM_EXIT.fix: Return a result or throw an exception and let main alone decide the exit status.

DM_FP_NUMBER_CTOR.fix: Use Double.valueOf(x) or Float.valueOf(x), or keep the primitive, instead of the Double or Float constructor.

DM_GC.fix: Delete the System.gc() or Runtime.gc() call and let the JVM schedule collection.

DM_INVALID_MIN_MAX.fix: Swap the clamp so the lower bound goes in Math.max and the upper in Math.min: Math.max(lo, Math.min(hi, x)).

DM_MONITOR_WAIT_ON_CONDITION.fix: Call await() on the Condition instead of wait(), which waits on the Condition object's own monitor.

DM_NEW_FOR_GETCLASS.fix: Write Foo.class, or call getClass() on an object you already have, instead of creating an object only to call getClass().

DM_NUMBER_CTOR.fix: Use Integer.valueOf(x) or the primitive instead of new Integer(x), new Long(x) and similar constructors.

DM_RUN_FINALIZERS_ON_EXIT.fix: Remove the call; register a shutdown hook with Runtime.addShutdownHook or use try-with-resources for cleanup.

DM_STRING_CTOR.fix: Use the String or literal directly; drop the new String(s) copy.

DM_STRING_TOSTRING.fix: Use the String itself; drop the toString() call on a String.

DM_STRING_VOID_CTOR.fix: Write the empty literal "" instead of new String().

DM_USELESS_THREAD.fix: Give the Thread a Runnable (new Thread(() -> work())), or submit the task to an ExecutorService.

DP_CREATE_CLASSLOADER_INSIDE_DO_PRIVILEG.fix: Use the existing context or application class loader instead of creating one; do not wrap it in AccessController, which is deprecated for removal.

DP_DO_INSIDE_DO_PRIVILEGED.fix: Avoid setAccessible and other reflective access; use the public API or MethodHandles.privateLookupIn. Do not add AccessController, which is deprecated.

EC_ARRAY_AND_NONARRAY.fix: Compare values of the same kind; use Arrays.equals(a, b) for arrays, never array.equals(object).

EC_BAD_ARRAY_COMPARE.fix: Use Arrays.equals(a, b), or Arrays.deepEquals for nested arrays, not array.equals(other).

EC_INCOMPATIBLE_ARRAY_COMPARE.fix: Compare arrays of the same element type with Arrays.equals; arrays of different types are never equal.

EC_NULL_ARG.fix: Remove the equals(null) call; use x == null for a null test.

EC_UNRELATED_CLASS_AND_INTERFACE.fix: Compare values of related types, or fix the declared types; equals between the class and interface is always false.

EC_UNRELATED_INTERFACES.fix: Compare values of related types, or fix the declared types; no class implements both interfaces, so equals is always false.

EC_UNRELATED_TYPES.fix: Compare values of the same type, or convert one side first; equals on unrelated types is always false.

EC_UNRELATED_TYPES_USING_POINTER_EQUALIT.fix: Compare values of related types, or fix the declared types; == between unrelated types is always false.

EI_EXPOSE_BUF.fix: Return buf.asReadOnlyBuffer() or a copy instead of the stored buffer.

EI_EXPOSE_BUF2.fix: Store buf.asReadOnlyBuffer() or a copy of the buffer instead of the caller's buffer.

EI_EXPOSE_REP.fix: Return a copy at the return statement: List.copyOf(items), Map.copyOf(m), array.clone(); returning a shared collaborator is the exception case.

EI_EXPOSE_REP2.fix: Store a copy of caller data (List.copyOf(items), array.clone(), Instant instead of Date); a shared injected collaborator is the exception case.

EI_EXPOSE_STATIC_BUF2.fix: Store a read-only or copied buffer in the static field, not the caller's buffer.

EI_EXPOSE_STATIC_REP2.fix: Store an immutable copy such as List.copyOf(items) in the static field, not the caller's object.

ENV_USE_PROPERTY_INSTEAD_OF_ENV.fix: Read a system property with System.getProperty, or take the setting through a config parameter instead of System.getenv.

EOS_BAD_END_OF_STREAM_CHECK.fix: Store read() in an int and compare that with -1 before casting to byte or char.

EQ_ABSTRACT_SELF.fix: Declare equals(Object) in the abstract class, or implement it there, instead of an abstract equals taking the class type.

EQ_ALWAYS_FALSE.fix: Compare the fields that define equality in equals; do not return false unconditionally.

EQ_ALWAYS_TRUE.fix: Compare the fields that define equality in equals; do not return true unconditionally.

EQ_CHECK_FOR_OPERAND_NOT_COMPATIBLE_WITH.fix: Compare only with arguments that are instances of this class: use if (!(o instanceof Foo other)) return false.

EQ_COMPARETO_USE_OBJECT_EQUALS.fix: Override equals so it agrees with compareTo, for example return o instanceof Foo f && compareTo(f) == 0.

EQ_COMPARING_CLASS_NAMES.fix: Compare classes with getClass() != o.getClass(), not by class name strings.

EQ_DOESNT_OVERRIDE_EQUALS.fix: Override equals and hashCode in the subclass to include its added fields, or hold the superclass as a field instead of extending it.

EQ_DONT_DEFINE_EQUALS_FOR_ENUM.fix: Delete the equals override in the enum; enum constants are compared by ==.

EQ_GETCLASS_AND_CLASS_CONSTANT.fix: Make the class final or compare with getClass() == o.getClass(), so a subclass does not break equals symmetry.

EQ_OTHER_NO_OBJECT.fix: Change the parameter to Object: public boolean equals(Object o), then cast after an instanceof check.

EQ_OTHER_USE_OBJECT.fix: Replace the differently named equals with public boolean equals(Object o).

EQ_OVERRIDING_EQUALS_NOT_SYMMETRIC.fix: Make equals symmetric: compare getClass() on both sides, or make equals final in the base class.

EQ_SELF_NO_OBJECT.fix: Override equals(Object) with the exact signature and mark it @Override instead of equals taking the class type.

EQ_SELF_USE_OBJECT.fix: Change equals(Foo) to public boolean equals(Object o) with an instanceof check and @Override.

EQ_UNUSUAL.fix: Write equals(Object) in the standard form: pattern instanceof check, then compare the fields with Objects.equals, or use a record.

ES_COMPARING_PARAMETER_STRING_WITH_EQ.fix: Compare strings with equals: CONSTANT.equals(param) or Objects.equals(a, b).

ES_COMPARING_STRINGS_WITH_EQ.fix: Compare strings with equals: CONSTANT.equals(s) or Objects.equals(a, b).

ESync_EMPTY_SYNC.fix: Remove the empty synchronized block, or move the code it was meant to protect inside it.

FB_MISSING_EXPECTED_WARNING.fix: Remove the stale @ExpectWarning annotation or restore the code that triggers the expected warning.

FB_UNEXPECTED_WARNING.fix: Fix the code that triggers the warning, or remove the @NoWarning annotation if the warning is accepted.

FE_FLOATING_POINT_EQUALITY.fix: Compare doubles with Math.abs(a - b) < EPSILON, or use BigDecimal.compareTo for exact values.

FE_TEST_IF_EQUAL_TO_NOT_A_NUMBER.fix: Test with Double.isNaN(x) (or Float.isNaN); x == Double.NaN is always false.

FI_EMPTY.fix: Delete the empty finalize method; use try-with-resources or java.lang.ref.Cleaner for cleanup.

FI_EXPLICIT_INVOCATION.fix: Remove the direct finalize() call and expose an explicit close() method that implements AutoCloseable.

FI_FINALIZER_NULLS_FIELDS.fix: Delete the finalizer; nulling fields does nothing for the garbage collector.

FI_FINALIZER_ONLY_NULLS_FIELDS.fix: Delete the finalizer; nulling fields does nothing for the garbage collector.

FI_MISSING_SUPER_CALL.fix: Delete finalize and use AutoCloseable or Cleaner; if it stays, end it with super.finalize() in a finally block.

FI_NULLIFY_SUPER.fix: Delete the finalizer that suppresses the superclass finalizer; cleanup belongs in AutoCloseable or Cleaner.

FI_PUBLIC_SHOULD_BE_PROTECTED.fix: Delete finalize and use AutoCloseable or Cleaner; do not widen it to public.

FL_FLOATS_AS_LOOP_COUNTERS.fix: Loop on an int counter and compute the float value from it: for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) { double x = i * step; }.

FL_MATH_USING_FLOAT_PRECISION.fix: Use double for the arithmetic, or BigDecimal when exact decimals matter.

FS_BAD_DATE_FORMAT_FLAG_COMBO.fix: Fix the pattern letters: pair h or K with a, use H without a, and yyyy (not YYYY) with MM and dd; build it with DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern.

GC_UNCHECKED_TYPE_IN_GENERIC_CALL.fix: Pass an argument of the collection's element type to contains, remove or get, or fix the declared generic type.

GC_UNRELATED_TYPES.fix: Pass an argument of the collection's element or key type to contains, remove or get; unrelated types never match.

HE_EQUALS_NO_HASHCODE.fix: Add hashCode that uses the same fields as equals: return Objects.hash(a, b), or make the class a record.

HE_EQUALS_USE_HASHCODE.fix: Add hashCode that uses the same fields as equals: return Objects.hash(a, b), or make the class a record.

HE_HASHCODE_NO_EQUALS.fix: Add an equals method over the same fields that hashCode uses, or make the class a record.

HE_HASHCODE_USE_OBJECT_EQUALS.fix: Add an equals method over the same fields that hashCode uses, or make the class a record.

HE_INHERITS_EQUALS_USE_HASHCODE.fix: Override hashCode together with equals using the same fields, or make the class a record.

HE_SIGNATURE_DECLARES_HASHING_OF_UNHASHA.fix: Define hashCode in the key class, or change the signature to a type that defines it, before using it in a HashMap or HashSet.

HE_USE_OF_UNHASHABLE_CLASS.fix: Define hashCode (and equals) in the class, or use IdentityHashMap if identity keys are wanted.

HRS_REQUEST_PARAMETER_TO_COOKIE.fix: Validate the request value against an allowlist or strict pattern before putting it in a Cookie.

HRS_REQUEST_PARAMETER_TO_HTTP_HEADER.fix: Validate the request value against an allowlist or strict pattern, rejecting CR and LF, before setting a header.

HSC_HUGE_SHARED_STRING_CONSTANT.fix: Load the large text from a resource file at startup instead of embedding it as a string constant in the class.

HSM_HIDING_METHOD.fix: Rename the static method, or make it an instance method, so it no longer hides the superclass method.

IA_AMBIGUOUS_INVOCATION_OF_INHERITED_OR_.fix: Call super.run() for the inherited method or Outer.this.run() for the outer one; this.run() compiles to the same call and keeps the finding.

ICAST_BAD_SHIFT_AMOUNT.fix: Shift by an amount from 0 to 31 for int, or make the value a long, e.g. 1L << n.

ICAST_IDIV_CAST_TO_DOUBLE.fix: Convert an operand before dividing, as in (double) a / b, so the division is not done in integers.

ICAST_INTEGER_MULTIPLY_CAST_TO_LONG.fix: Widen an operand before multiplying, as in (long) a * b, or use Math.multiplyExact.

ICAST_INT_2_LONG_AS_INSTANT.fix: Convert to long before multiplying, e.g. Instant.ofEpochMilli(seconds * 1000L), or use Instant.ofEpochSecond.

ICAST_INT_CAST_TO_DOUBLE_PASSED_TO_CEIL.fix: Divide as doubles, Math.ceil((double) a / b), or use Math.ceilDiv(a, b).

ICAST_INT_CAST_TO_FLOAT_PASSED_TO_ROUND.fix: Divide as floats or doubles before Math.round, e.g. Math.round((double) a / b); integer division already truncated.

ICAST_QUESTIONABLE_UNSIGNED_RIGHT_SHIFT.fix: Use >> when the cast keeps only bits the sign cannot reach, or keep an int with (x >>> n) & 0xFF instead of casting to byte or short.

IC_INIT_CIRCULARITY.fix: Move the shared constants or setup into a third class so the two classes no longer initialize each other.

IC_SUPERCLASS_USES_SUBCLASS_DURING_INITI.fix: Move the subclass reference out of the superclass static initializer into a lazy holder class or a method.

IIL_ELEMENTS_GET_LENGTH_IN_LOOP.fix: Read nodes.getLength() once into a local int before the loop and use that local in the loop condition.

IIL_PATTERN_COMPILE_IN_LOOP.fix: Compile the regex once into a private static final Pattern field and reuse it inside the loop.

IIL_PATTERN_COMPILE_IN_LOOP_INDIRECT.fix: Compile the regex once into a private static final Pattern field, and use that field in the method the loop calls.

IIL_PREPARE_STATEMENT_IN_LOOP.fix: Prepare the statement once before the loop in try-with-resources, then set parameters and call addBatch inside the loop.

IIO_INEFFICIENT_INDEX_OF.fix: Pass a char to indexOf (s.indexOf('x')) instead of a one-character String.

IIO_INEFFICIENT_LAST_INDEX_OF.fix: Pass a char to lastIndexOf (s.lastIndexOf('x')) instead of a one-character String.

IJU_ASSERT_METHOD_INVOKED_FROM_RUN_METHO.fix: Do not assert inside a run method; capture the result or exception and assert it on the test thread after join.

IJU_BAD_SUITE_METHOD.fix: Replace the JUnit 3 suite method with JUnit 5 @Test methods; use @Suite or @Nested for grouping.

IJU_NO_TESTS.fix: Stop extending TestCase: write JUnit 5 @Test methods in a plain class, or delete the class.

IJU_SETUP_NO_SUPER.fix: Move to JUnit 5 and use @BeforeEach with no inheritance; if staying on TestCase, call super.setUp().

IJU_SUITE_NOT_STATIC.fix: Replace the JUnit 3 suite method with JUnit 5 @Test methods; if staying on TestCase, make suite() public static.

IJU_TEARDOWN_NO_SUPER.fix: Move to JUnit 5 and use @AfterEach with no inheritance; if staying on TestCase, call super.tearDown().

IL_CONTAINER_ADDED_TO_ITSELF.fix: Add a different collection or element; a collection added to itself breaks hashCode and toString.

IL_INFINITE_LOOP.fix: Make the loop condition depend on a variable the body changes, or add a break or return that ends it.

SF_SWITCH_NO_DEFAULT.fix: Add a default branch, or use an exhaustive switch expression over an enum or sealed type.

SIC_INNER_SHOULD_BE_STATIC.fix: Declare the nested class static, since it never uses the outer instance; make it a record if it only holds data.

SIC_INNER_SHOULD_BE_STATIC_ANON.fix: Replace the anonymous class with a lambda or a static nested class that does not capture the outer instance.

SIC_INNER_SHOULD_BE_STATIC_NEEDS_THIS.fix: Declare the nested class static and pass the outer instance in through its constructor.

SIC_THREADLOCAL_DEADLY_EMBRACE.fix: Make the inner class a static nested class so it does not hold the outer instance.

SING_SINGLETON_GETTER_NOT_SYNCHRONIZED.fix: Use a single-element enum, or an eager private static final instance, instead of lazy unsynchronized creation.

SING_SINGLETON_HAS_NONPRIVATE_CONSTRUCTO.fix: Make the singleton's constructor private, or use a single-element enum.

SING_SINGLETON_IMPLEMENTS_CLONEABLE.fix: Remove Cloneable from the singleton; use a single-element enum.

SING_SINGLETON_IMPLEMENTS_CLONE_METHOD.fix: Delete clone from the singleton, or make it throw CloneNotSupportedException; a single-element enum avoids it.

SING_SINGLETON_IMPLEMENTS_SERIALIZABLE.fix: Make the singleton a single-element enum, or stop implementing Serializable; a readResolve method does not clear this finding.

SING_SINGLETON_INDIRECTLY_IMPLEMENTS_CLO.fix: Do not inherit Cloneable in a singleton; use a single-element enum or override clone to throw.

SIO_SUPERFLUOUS_INSTANCEOF.fix: Remove the instanceof test; the static type already guarantees it, so it is always true.

SI_INSTANCE_BEFORE_FINALS_ASSIGNED.fix: Declare the instance field after every other static final field, or use a lazy holder class to create the instance.

SKIPPED_CLASS_TOO_BIG.fix: Split the class into smaller classes so analysis can cover all of it.

SP_SPIN_ON_FIELD.fix: Wait with a CountDownLatch, a Condition or wait and notify instead of polling a field in a loop.

SQL_BAD_PREPARED_STATEMENT_ACCESS.fix: Set parameters from index 1, setString(1, value); JDBC indexes start at 1, not 0.

SQL_BAD_RESULTSET_ACCESS.fix: Read columns from index 1, rs.getString(1), or by column name; JDBC indexes start at 1.

SQL_NONCONSTANT_STRING_PASSED_TO_EXECUTE.fix: Use a PreparedStatement with a constant SQL string and ? placeholders, and bind the values with setString and setInt.

SQL_PREPARED_STATEMENT_GENERATED_FROM_NO.fix: Use a constant SQL string with ? placeholders and bind the values; build only placeholders or allowlisted identifiers, never user text, into the SQL.

SR_NOT_CHECKED.fix: Check the number of bytes returned by skip, or use skipNBytes, so a short skip is handled.

SSD_DO_NOT_USE_INSTANCE_LOCK_ON_SHARED_S.fix: Guard the static data with a private static final lock Object, not an instance lock or a synchronized instance method.

SS_SHOULD_BE_STATIC.fix: Declare the final field with a constant initializer as static final.

STCAL_INVOKE_ON_STATIC_CALENDAR_INSTANCE.fix: Use java.time types (LocalDate, ZonedDateTime) instead of calling a shared static Calendar.

STCAL_INVOKE_ON_STATIC_DATE_FORMAT_INSTA.fix: Format with a static final DateTimeFormatter, which is thread-safe, instead of a shared DateFormat.

STCAL_STATIC_CALENDAR_INSTANCE.fix: Replace the static Calendar with java.time types (Instant, LocalDate, ZonedDateTime), which are immutable.

STCAL_STATIC_SIMPLE_DATE_FORMAT_INSTANCE.fix: Replace the static SimpleDateFormat with a static final DateTimeFormatter, which is thread-safe.

STI_INTERRUPTED_ON_CURRENTTHREAD.fix: Call the static Thread.interrupted() directly, or Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted() to read without clearing.

STI_INTERRUPTED_ON_UNKNOWNTHREAD.fix: Use thread.isInterrupted() to read another thread's flag; interrupted() always checks the current thread and clears the flag.

ST_WRITE_TO_STATIC_FROM_INSTANCE_METHOD.fix: Keep the state in an instance field, or move the write to a static method that guards it with a lock or an Atomic type.

SWL_SLEEP_WITH_LOCK_HELD.fix: Release the lock before Thread.sleep, or wait with a timeout on a Condition (await(time, unit)).

SW_SWING_METHODS_INVOKED_IN_SWING_THREAD.fix: Build and show Swing components inside SwingUtilities.invokeLater.

TESTING.fix: Nothing is wrong in the code: this is a SpotBugs self-test pattern, which only appears when a testing detector is enabled.

TESTING1.fix: Nothing is wrong in the code: this is a SpotBugs self-test pattern, which only appears when a testing detector is enabled.

TESTING2.fix: Nothing is wrong in the code: this is a SpotBugs self-test pattern, which only appears when a testing detector is enabled.

TESTING3.fix: Nothing is wrong in the code: this is a SpotBugs self-test pattern, which only appears when a testing detector is enabled.

THROWS_METHOD_THROWS_CLAUSE_BASIC_EXCEPT.fix: Declare the specific checked exception the method throws, such as IOException, not Exception.

THROWS_METHOD_THROWS_CLAUSE_THROWABLE.fix: Declare the specific checked exception the method throws, such as IOException, not Throwable.

THROWS_METHOD_THROWS_RUNTIMEEXCEPTION.fix: Throw a specific type instead of new RuntimeException(...): IllegalStateException, IllegalArgumentException, UncheckedIOException or a domain exception.

TLW_TWO_LOCK_WAIT.fix: Wait while holding only the monitor you wait on; release the outer lock first, or use one lock.

TQ_ALWAYS_VALUE_USED_WHERE_NEVER_REQUIRE.fix: Pass a value that does not carry the qualifier, or fix the qualifier annotation on the parameter or field.

TQ_COMPARING_VALUES_WITH_INCOMPATIBLE_TY.fix: Compare values with the same type qualifier, or fix the annotations; the two sides can never be equal.

TQ_EXPLICIT_UNKNOWN_SOURCE_VALUE_REACHES.fix: Remove the unknown-source annotation from the value, or make the source carry the qualifier the sink requires.
Remove the unknown-source annotation from the value, or make the source guarantee it lacks the forbidden qualifier.

TQ_MAYBE_SOURCE_VALUE_REACHES_ALWAYS_SIN.fix: Make the source always carry the qualifier, or validate the value before it reaches the annotated parameter.

TQ_MAYBE_SOURCE_VALUE_REACHES_NEVER_SINK.fix: Make sure the value never carries the qualifier before it reaches the annotated parameter, or fix the annotations.

TQ_NEVER_VALUE_USED_WHERE_ALWAYS_REQUIRE.fix: Pass a value that carries the required qualifier, or fix the annotations on the source or the parameter.

TQ_UNKNOWN_VALUE_USED_WHERE_ALWAYS_STRIC.fix: Pass a value from a source annotated with the required qualifier, or convert it through a method that returns the annotated type.

UCF_USELESS_CONTROL_FLOW.fix: Remove the if or loop with an empty body, or put the intended statements in it.

UCF_USELESS_CONTROL_FLOW_NEXT_LINE.fix: Remove the stray semicolon after the condition, so the if guards the statement on the next line.

UC_USELESS_CONDITION.fix: Remove the condition that the known value range makes always true or false, or test the right variable.

UC_USELESS_CONDITION_TYPE.fix: Remove the comparison that the variable's type already decides, or compare against the intended variable.

UC_USELESS_OBJECT.fix: Remove the collection or object that is filled but never read, or return or use it.

UC_USELESS_OBJECT_STACK.fix: Remove the object that is only modified and never read, or use its result.

UC_USELESS_VOID_METHOD.fix: Delete the void method that does nothing, or give it the intended effect.

UG_SYNC_SET_UNSYNC_GET.fix: Make the getter synchronized too, or replace both with a volatile or atomic field.

UI_INHERITANCE_UNSAFE_GETRESOURCE.fix: Call Foo.class.getResource(name) with the class literal instead of getClass().getResource(name).

UL_UNRELEASED_LOCK.fix: Call lock.lock() just before a try block and put unlock() in its finally.

UL_UNRELEASED_LOCK_EXCEPTION_PATH.fix: Put unlock() in a finally block so every exception path releases the lock.

UMAC_UNCALLABLE_METHOD_OF_ANONYMOUS_CLAS.fix: Delete the unreachable method, or fix its name and signature so it overrides the supertype method; add @Override.

UM_UNNECESSARY_MATH.fix: Replace the Math call on a constant with its literal result.

UNKNOWN.fix: SpotBugs reported a pattern it has no description for; read the bug type in the report and fix or except it like any other finding.

UPM_UNCALLED_PRIVATE_METHOD.fix: Delete the private method that nothing calls.

URF_UNREAD_FIELD.fix: Delete the field that is written but never read, or read it where the value is needed.

URF_UNREAD_PUBLIC_OR_PROTECTED_FIELD.fix: Delete the field that is written but never read, or read it where the value is needed.

UR_UNINIT_READ.fix: Assign the field in the constructor before it is read, or make it final and set it from a parameter.

UR_UNINIT_READ_CALLED_FROM_SUPER_CONSTRU.fix: Do not call overridable methods from a constructor; make the method final or private, or move the call to a factory.

USC_POTENTIAL_SECURITY_CHECK_BASED_ON_UN.fix: Make a defensive copy of the untrusted value before the security check, then use only the copy afterward.

USM_USELESS_ABSTRACT_METHOD.fix: Delete the abstract method; the implemented interface already declares it.

USM_USELESS_SUBCLASS_METHOD.fix: Delete the override that only calls super with the same arguments.

US_USELESS_SUPPRESSION_ON_CLASS.fix: Delete the SuppressFBWarnings annotation on the class; it suppresses nothing.

US_USELESS_SUPPRESSION_ON_FIELD.fix: Delete the SuppressFBWarnings annotation on the field; it suppresses nothing.

US_USELESS_SUPPRESSION_ON_METHOD.fix: Delete the SuppressFBWarnings annotation on the method; it suppresses nothing.

US_USELESS_SUPPRESSION_ON_METHOD_PARAMET.fix: Delete the SuppressFBWarnings annotation on the parameter; it suppresses nothing.

US_USELESS_SUPPRESSION_ON_PACKAGE.fix: Delete the SuppressFBWarnings annotation on the package; it suppresses nothing.

UUF_UNUSED_FIELD.fix: Delete the field that is never used.

UUF_UNUSED_PUBLIC_OR_PROTECTED_FIELD.fix: Delete the field that is never used, or make it private if only the class needs it.

UWF_FIELD_NOT_INITIALIZED_IN_CONSTRUCTOR.fix: Assign the field in every constructor and make it private final, so it is never null when dereferenced.

UWF_NULL_FIELD.fix: Assign a non-null value to the field somewhere, or delete the field; it is only ever null.

UWF_UNWRITTEN_FIELD.fix: Assign the field somewhere, or delete it; reading a never-written field always yields null or zero.

UWF_UNWRITTEN_PUBLIC_OR_PROTECTED_FIELD.fix: Assign the field in the constructor and make it private final, or remove it if nothing sets it.

UW_UNCOND_WAIT.fix: Test the condition under the lock and call wait only while it is false, inside a while loop.

VA_PRIMITIVE_ARRAY_PASSED_TO_OBJECT_VARA.fix: Pass a boxed array (Integer[]) or the elements individually; a primitive array arrives as one Object argument.

VO_VOLATILE_INCREMENT.fix: Use AtomicInteger or AtomicLong (incrementAndGet) instead of ++ on a volatile field.

VO_VOLATILE_REFERENCE_TO_ARRAY.fix: Use AtomicReferenceArray or replace the whole array with a copy; volatile covers the reference, not the elements.

VR_UNRESOLVABLE_REFERENCE.fix: Add the missing class to the analysis classpath (the dependency in build.gradle), or remove the reference to it.

VSC_VULNERABLE_SECURITY_CHECK_METHODS.fix: Make the security-checked method private or final, so a subclass cannot override it.

WA_AWAIT_NOT_IN_LOOP.fix: Call Condition.await inside a while loop that rechecks the condition after waking.

WA_NOT_IN_LOOP.fix: Call wait inside a while loop that rechecks the condition after waking.

WL_USING_GETCLASS_RATHER_THAN_CLASS_LITE.fix: Synchronize on the class literal Foo.class, or better a private static final lock Object, not getClass().

WMI_WRONG_MAP_ITERATOR.fix: Iterate map.entrySet() and read getKey() and getValue() instead of iterating keySet() and calling get(key).

WS_WRITEOBJECT_SYNC.fix: Remove synchronized from writeObject, or synchronize the other methods that touch the same state.

XFB_XML_FACTORY_BYPASS.fix: Create XML objects through the factory (DocumentBuilderFactory, SAXParserFactory, TransformerFactory), not by instantiating an implementation class.

XSS_REQUEST_PARAMETER_TO_JSP_WRITER.fix: Escape the request value for HTML output, or use a templating layer that escapes by default, before writing it.

XSS_REQUEST_PARAMETER_TO_SEND_ERROR.fix: Do not put the request value in the error message; send a fixed message, or escape the value for HTML first.

XSS_REQUEST_PARAMETER_TO_SERVLET_WRITER.fix: Escape the request value for HTML output, or use a templating layer that escapes by default, before writing it.
